title: Witch with Pumpkin Lanterns
description: A female character with vibrant pink hair, glasses, and a black witch hat sits on a wooden ledge. She wears a dark corset-style outfit with a white skirt, long gloves, and thigh-high boots while holding two glowing carved pumpkin lanterns, one in each hand.
prompt: A seductive young witch with long flowing pink hair and round glasses, wearing a black and white corset dress with a short skirt, long black gloves, and brown thigh-high boots, sits on a wooden beam in a dark spooky environment.
